91:1.text: By the sun and its brightness.

91:2.text: By the moon as it follows it

91:3.text: By the day as it shows up

91:4.text: By the night as it conceals it

91:5.text: By the heaven and Him Who built it.

91:6.text: By the earth and Him Who spread it.

91:7.text: (Adam or a person or a soul)
, and Him Who perfected him in proportion;

91:8.text: Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him.

91:9.text: Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself
(i.e. obeys and performs all that Allâh ordered, by following the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds)

91:10.text: And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself
(i.e. disobeys what Allâh has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism or by following polytheism or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds)

91:11.text: (by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin)

91:12.text: When the most wicked man among them went forth

91:13.text: . That is the she-camel of Allâh!
and bar it not from having its drink!"

91:14.text: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction
(i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)

92:1.text: By the night as it envelops.

92:2.text: By the day as it appears in brightness.

92:3.text: By Him Who created male and female.

92:4.text: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse

92:5.text: and keeps his duty to Allâh and fears Him,

92:7.text: We will make smooth for him the path of ease

92:8.text: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.

92:9.text: (See the footnote of the Verse No.6)

92:10.text: We will make smooth for him the path for evil.

92:11.text: And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down

92:14.text: Therefore I have warned you of a blazing Fire
